full_details: You were on foot from the start. There is no morning scene in it. At midday the string was ahead of you, bells on the leader, Hobbins's back, and the dust. Near there a hired rider who had gone by at a hand-gallop was leading the horse lame, and Hobbins did not turn his head. Against a horse's flank you put the friar on the tables, and under him the second act as a list. Dawn on that list is the friar's dawn. Oxford by six, twenty miles, the back no worse. Supper among gowns was nine pence. A scholar at the next board was construing Ovid for a wager, and he was wrong, and you did not correct him. By the rush-light you read the orchard sheets once, found voices that are not in them, did not write those down, and put the sheets away.
one_sentence: You walked the whole day at the horses' pace, passed a hired rider and his lame horse, and at Oxford you read the orchard sheets and put them away.
title: Wisely and slow, written on the tables
